description.en: Cantabria is an autonomous community and province in northern Spain with Santander as its capital city. It is called a comunidad histórica, a historic community, in its current statute of autonomy.
description.zh-CN: 坎塔布里亚自治区是西班牙的自治區。它北鄰坎塔布連海、南接卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂、西鄰阿斯圖里亞斯、東連巴斯克地区。
description.zh-TW: 坎塔布里亞自治區是西班牙的自治區。它北鄰坎塔布連海、南接卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂、西鄰阿斯圖裏亞斯、東連巴斯克地區。

photo.alt: Source of the river Ason in the Natural Park Hillocks of the Ason (Cantabria, Spain). Resurgent stream in a karst region. The water falls by a cascade of more than 50 meters of height.
